summary: Delegate only bounded work with independent acceptance and explicit resource ownership.
instructions: Give each worker a task contract, input boundary, write scope, resource lease, expected artifact, and deterministic acceptance checks.
Use weaker or external models only after privacy, provider trust, tool, risk, cost, and verification constraints pass.
Never request, echo, log, or store API key values in chat, Git, Skills, .research, or task artifacts; resolve them from approved environment variables or a user-level secret store.
Onboarding smoke proves connectivity only. Update model profiles solely from independently evaluated real tasks and human corrections.
Inject only human-approved model-specific prompt overlays; worker self-assessment never accepts work.
Parallel agents must not write the same files or contend for the same exclusive hardware.
